cards.meaning: sifting; screening out (as in culling items from a budget)
cards.example: Sinimulan ng Senado ang pagsala sa mga bagong proyekto ng DPWH.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Senate began screening the DPWH's new projects.
cards.note: Pormal; may kasamang hatol: may natitira at may natatanggal. Mas matalas kaysa 'pagbusisi'. Pandiwa: salain.
cards.tiesTo: Senate purge of unsupported items in the P7.2T 2027 budget

cards.example: Ayon kay Lacson, 'all means all' ang pagtutuos sa badyet.
cards.exampleMeaning: According to Lacson, the budget reckoning is 'all means all'.
cards.note: May dalawang mukha: pormal na pagkuwenta sa negosyo, at 'huling pagtutuos' sa pulitika na may paniningil at pananagutan.
cards.tiesTo: Lacson and Ejercito on the 2027 budget review

cards.meaning: have no choice but to; can only
cards.example: 出口商只好降价来保住订单。
cards.examplePinyin: Chūkǒushāng zhǐhǎo jiàngjià lái bǎozhù dìngdān.
cards.exampleMeaning: Exporters have no choice but to cut prices to hold on to orders.
cards.note: 中性偏口语;常与'于是''所以'连用。比'不得不'更无奈,比'只能'带有感情色彩。 Resigned second-best; softer than 不得不, more emotional than 只能.
cards.tiesTo: China exporters cutting prices in the October private PMI

cards.meaning: to bear; to withstand (pressure, losses, risk)
cards.example: 利润越来越少,很多工厂已经难以承受。
cards.examplePinyin: Lìrùn yuè lái yuè shǎo, hěn duō gōngchǎng yǐjīng nányǐ chéngshòu.
cards.exampleMeaning: Profits keep shrinking and many factories can no longer bear it.
cards.note: 书面语;常搭配压力、损失、风险、后果。 Formal; about capacity to hold a load. 忍受 = endure something unpleasant; 接受 = accept.
cards.tiesTo: Margin squeeze and a fast-appreciating yuan for exporters
